description: Runs one short interview with a founder about their working day. Given this interview's questions and answers so far, it returns the next question (start, work, problem, resolution, forward), following up on what they said. When the interview is complete it returns done, a summary of the day in the founder's own words, a closing line and a link that opens Underway with the debrief loaded. Use it when a founder wants to talk through their day now, in this chat. If they already know they want to film and only want it set up, use underway_set_up_recording instead.

messages.description: This interview so far, in order: each question underway_debrief returned (role assistant) and the founder's answer to it (role user). Nothing else from the chat. Empty at the start.

name: underway_debrief

link.description: Opens underway.life with this debrief already loaded, only when done.

next_question.description: The next question in the interview. Null when done.

summary.description: The founder's day in their own words, only when done.

title: Run a debrief
